accepted.question_text: Let X be a nonsingular projective variety over C, let M_g(X, beta) be the moduli space of stable maps to X in curve class beta, let M_g be the moduli space of genus-g stable curves, and let pi: M_g(X, beta) -> M_g be the forgetful morphism. The stable-map space has a virtual fundamental class [M_g(X, beta)]^vir from deformation theory. Is the pushforward class pi_*([M_g(X, beta)]^vir) always contained in the tautological subring of H_*(M_g)?

evidence.quote: Q1. Does π∗[Mg(X, β)]vir ∈ H∗ (Mg) lie in the tautological ring in coho￾mology?

accepted.question_text: In the same setting where X is a nonsingular projective variety over C, M_g(X, beta) is the moduli space of stable maps, pi: M_g(X, beta) -> M_g is the forgetful morphism, and [M_g(X, beta)]^vir is the virtual class, for which targets X and curve classes beta does the Chow-theoretic pushforward pi_*([M_g(X, beta)]^vir) lie in the tautological subring of A_*(M_g)?

evidence.quote: Q2. When does π∗[Mg(X, β)]vir ∈ A∗ (Mg) lie in the tautological ring in Chow?

accepted.question_text: For the Gromov-Witten theory of a target variety X, prove that the full set of Virasoro constraints holds when X is an Enriques surface.

evidence.quote: Q3. Prove the Virasoro constraints in case X is an Enriques surface.

accepted.question_text: For a nonsingular projective 3-fold X, establish the conjectural equivalence between Gromov-Witten curve counting and Donaldson-Thomas curve counting, i.e., prove the GW/DT correspondence for 3-folds.

evidence.quote: Q4. Prove the GW/DT correspondence for 3-folds.

accepted.question_text: Define Donaldson-Thomas invariants for varieties of dimension greater than 3 by providing a mathematically sound framework that extends the 3-fold theory.

evidence.quote: Q5. Define Donaldson–Thomas invariants in dimensions > 3.

accepted.question_text: Let M_{2n}^{K3} denote the moduli space of polarized K3 surfaces (S, L) with L^2 = 2n. What should be the correct analogue of the tautological ring in the cycle theory of M_{2n}^{K3}?

evidence.quote: Q6. What is the analogue of the tautological ring for MK3 2n ?

accepted.question_text: For the moduli space M_{2n}^{K3} of polarized K3 surfaces of degree 2n, do the Noether-Lefschetz divisor classes generate the rational Picard group, i.e., do they span Pic(M_{2n}^{K3}) tensor Q?

evidence.quote: Q7. Do the Noether-Lefschetz divisors span Pic(MK3 2n ) ⊗Z Q?

accepted.question_text: For K3 surfaces, prove the Katz-Klemm-Vafa conjecture in every genus and for all curve classes.

evidence.quote: Q8. Prove the Katz-Klemm-Vafa conjecture for in all genera and in all classes on K3 surfaces.

accepted.question_text: Develop effective mathematical techniques for computing higher-genus Gromov-Witten invariants of compact Calabi-Yau 3-folds.

evidence.quote: Q9. Find effective mathematical methods for calculating the higher genus Gromov-Witten invariants of compact Calabi-Yau 3-folds.
